notes.title: What's new in the release and future plans
notes.notes:
Got some feed back, send to us here.

[url=https://discord.gg/H9xBhunPJJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/9c633cb6a8c91f9357ea4852fa0077f939766723.png[/img][/url]

What's new?

The research table is where your colonists can research new technologies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/b7671ef124ce91ef026f889c1b3825162b34f04c.png[/img]

The air balloon was where the colonists would dive down to
extract ore from the ground and refine it into bars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/ef2c90001569f0432874d8ce65c9a5fe55e37f80.png[/img]

Iron Ore and Iron Bar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/dac12295a21ac72c7051b393be7f9fdc37a595eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/603cc7b0e9817e522dfa4055c75f43328768bcc1.png[/img]

Electric Section

Battery stores electrical energy for later use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/3ccf1a9533eeb841e290461ce0f8af8e24ca5c03.png[/img]

Wind turbines produce energy in amounts that directly vary with wind speed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/ad315ae8e3c5772fd0d74d87c0b7fa1634199e24.png[/img]

Air conditioner that are used to lower the temperature in a room to
prevent perishable goods such as food from spoiling, requiring energy to operate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038881/0fd7d352b3372ec6e822b6edd415728b1d9a176f.png[/img]

New Mechanics

Spoil and perish System

Now, the things that are not in the room will gradually be removed, and the food will also spoil if the temperature is not cold enough.

Peaceful mode (no zombie waves) can be toggled on or off in the game menu.

Reduces the cost of building walls, which makes the early game easier to play.

Future plans

I will make a save and trade system. which will come out soon

Thank you for your support.

notes.notes:
The first public demo of Avian Colony will be available at 23 Aug, 2024!

[previewyoutube=_sgEgdhaLsg;full][/previewyoutube]
List of feature.
[list]
[*] Efficient Use of Space: Make efficient use of the available floating space by planning your layout carefully to maximize productivity and defense.
[*] Resource Management: Gather and manage essential resources such as food and building materials to sustain your colony.
[*] Health: Keep an eye on the health of your colonists. Ensure they are well-fed, healthy.
[*] Combat Strategy: Develop and implement strategic defense plans to repel attacks from hostile forces.
[*] Prepare for the Worst: Always be prepared for unexpected challenges by maintaining reserves of essential resources.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175660/Avian_Colony_Demo/

notes.title: Avian Colony Timeline
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

I am finally ready to announce the project, Avian Colony.

I've been working on this project for about two years now, and are finally at a point were I can share the news!

The Avian Colony is a survival sim game.
The game features resource management and combat, you crashland on empty sky and have to build honme on it.

We are aiming to release on November 2024, there will be a public demo at September 2024.

Check out the Alpha Gameplay Teaser (everything in this trailer is Work In Progress).

[previewyoutube=K1QSnMARNdo;full][/previewyoutube]
